Knowing the current loss before output removes the positive gradient-energy term and retains negative squared movement. The initial comparator potential can still make the total bound positive. Finite-dimensional real inner-product E with NormedAddCommGroup E, InnerProductSpace ℝ E and FiniteDimensional ℝ E. V is closed, nonempty and convex. Played EReal losses have no bottom anywhere, are finite on V, and have ambient global supports at every point of V. Each supplied x(t+1) actually attains the squared-distance-penalized minimum on V; initialization x(0)=x0 is fixed. x0 need not belong to V. There is no affine, smooth-loss, globally finite-loss, bounded-gradient or bounded-domain restriction.

MODEL
Receive the entire current loss before choosing the new point and pay that loss at the new point. Lean loss t and eta t are source round t+1: center x(t), output/paid point x(t+1). This differs from ordinary OGD, which scores loss t at x(t). The conclusion identifies the SAME partial Option iterate at every prefix; it is conditional on attained updates and does not assert universal existence.
ASSUMPTIONS
Finite-dimensional real inner-product E with NormedAddCommGroup E, InnerProductSpace ℝ E and FiniteDimensional ℝ E. V is closed, nonempty and convex. Played EReal losses have no bottom anywhere, are finite on V, and have ambient global supports at every point of V. Each supplied x(t+1) actually attains the squared-distance-penalized minimum on V; initialization x(0)=x0 is fixed. x0 need not belong to V. There is no affine, smooth-loss, globally finite-loss, bounded-gradient or bounded-domain restriction.
ALGORITHM PARAMETERS
Variable: T>0, every used step positive, adjacent played steps nonincreasing, max indices0..T-1, last eta(T-1). Fixed: eta>0 and any T including0.
REGRET NOTION
R_T(u)=sum_{t<T}((loss t (x(t+1))).toReal-(loss t u).toReal), for every u in V; scoring is finite on V.
GUARANTEE
Each endpoint concludes canonical Option-run equality AND its full signed bound. The shared geometry theorem computes the actual derivative and exact ordered divergence; on complete real Hilbert space it is an explicit generalization of source Euclidean geometry.

Proof idea
Differentiate psi(z)=||z||²/2 to obtain the actual gradient y at y. Substitute the resulting derivative into the shared divergence and expand the squared norm to get Bpsi(x;y)=||x-y||²/2. This geometry theorem makes no algorithm-run conclusion.

code.text: theorem euclidean_variable_regret (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVn : V.Nonempty) (hVc : IsClosed V) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) (hinit : x 0 = x0) (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t) (hbot : ∀ t < T, ∀ z, loss t z ≠ ⊥) (hdom : ∀ t < T, V ⊆ BanditRL.OnlineConvex.effectiveDomain (loss t)) (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty) (hmin : ∀ t < T, x (t + 1) ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + ((‖z - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t) : ℝ) : EReal)) V (x (t + 1))) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) : (∀ t ≤ T, iterate V (fun z : E => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) η loss x0 t = some (x t)) ∧ (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤ ((range T).sup' (nonempty_range_iff.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hT)) (fun t => ‖u - x t‖ ^ 2 / 2)) / η (T - 1) - ∑ t ∈ range T, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t)
